prompt_inputs.goal: Marathon race day preparation with carbohydrate loading and maximum caloric intake for endurance performance

solution_criteria: Meal plan contains exactly one day of meals with sufficient calories (3500-4500 kcal) for a marathon runner
Includes high carbohydrate content (60-70% of total calories) to support endurance performance
Provides 3 main meals and 2-3 snacks distributed throughout the day
All meals are practical, digestible options suitable for pre-race preparation
task_description: Write a compact, concise 1 day meal plan for a single meal plan for a single athlete
scenario: Testing with a high-endurance athlete (marathon runner) requiring maximum caloric intake and carbohydrate loading for performance

solution_criteria: Meal plan covers one full day with at least 4 meals/snacks
Protein distributed evenly across meals (minimum 25g per meal)
Total daily protein intake supports muscle recovery (approximately 1.6-2.2g per kg body weight)
Meals are practical and compact to prepare for an athlete's schedule

prompt_inputs.goal: Optimize energy and recovery for competitive swimming training with 2 pool sessions daily
prompt_inputs.restrictions: No solid foods 2 hours before water training, lactose intolerant, no shellfish

solution_criteria: Meal plan spans exactly 1 day with timing suitable for swimmer (meals/snacks positioned away from 2-hour pre-training window)
All foods are easily digestible and safe for lactose-intolerant athlete with no shellfish
Plan is compact and concise (minimal verbosity, clear formatting)
